metadata.experiment: Bear survival: fixed learners with and without continuous distractors
metadata.uncertainty: Dots are separate simulated datasets; SD is sample standard deviation across seeds, not a confidence interval.
metadata.paired_design: Within each seed every learner and representation shares B, A, all noise draws, Y, and train/test indices. Only the independent distractor columns are added.
metadata.dgp: B,A independently Bernoulli(0.5); Z1,...,Z10 independently Uniform(0,1); E independently standard Logistic; Y=1[-1+2*1[B=A]+E>0].
metadata.nested_distractors: Original B/L/first-three-noise/outcome-error draws retain their original order. Additional columns use default_rng(SeedSequence([seed,4728,20261123])) and are drawn column-by-column after the original task is fixed.
metadata.oracle_note: Population AUC of the true conditional probability, not an upper bound on every finite test-sample AUC.

cpu_execution.controller: stdlib-only parent; sklearn phase exits before fresh per-cell foundation workers

signal_only_reuse.execution_note: Unchanged controls used native cached storage and stage limits 8/32/1. Current distractor fits use the same per-member cached calculations with disk-streamed native caches and independent stage limits 1/8/1. Small-network stage/cache parity and end-to-end four-member classifier parity are recorded; no attention sequence, row, feature or ensemble member is removed.
signal_only_reuse.reason: Adding independent distractor columns leaves the two-column signal-only inputs, outcomes, and splits unchanged. Model settings, versions, checkpoint, execution adapter, and per-seed oracle test scores were checked before reuse.
